label: K-Breathe
description: Displays live breathing data from the Tymewear VitalPro sensor on your Karoo. Includes VE, breathing rate, tidal volume, mobilization index, VE graph, and time-in-zones fields with FIT recording.
releaseNotes: Bulletproof BLE connection: GATT cache refresh after firmware updates, unlimited two-phase reconnection, data watchdog for silent disconnects, GATT error 133 handling. Fix scan failing when sensor_id pref is empty. Updated default zone thresholds.
